answer: Policies are written in harbor, settled in beacon, and tide lists every payout. Peers may post insurance against an identity's behaviour and collect 29% of its slashed stake when it misbehaves, creating a market that profits from finding fraud. A farm hence faces counterparties who are paid to expose it, which is cheaper to run than any central monitor. Repeating the trick 8 times costs 19 separate deposits and 32 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
